content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose geographic restrictions, leaving creators in regions like Africa without viable options. COREMERCH leverages blockchain technology to enable creators to accept cryptocurrency payments with minimal fees and no KYC requirements. This infrastructure empowers you to maintain full ownership of your digital products and data while ensuring secure and fast transactions through networks like Tron, which settles USDT in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To begin, you’ll need a few foundational tools: a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for backend logic and order storage, and a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency payment processing. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, templates, or courses. Finally, familiarize yourself with the deployment steps outlined in the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes blueprints and templates to streamline your setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by setting up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which will handle your order processing. Next, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without account restrictions. Use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for secure file delivery. This setup not only ensures fast and secure transactions but also provides your customers with immediate access to the products they purchase.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographic barriers, empowering creators globally.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to launch. Publish your site through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring all links and product pages are functional. Promote your store across your networks, targeting international buyers who seek digital products. When a customer places an order, the NOWPayments integration will automatically trigger a webhook for payment confirmation, allowing you to streamline the transaction process and enhance customer satisfaction.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your store, consider scaling by adding more products or utilizing additional marketing channels. Monitor your analytics to understand your customers’ behavior and optimize your offerings accordingly. Use the scaling playbook included in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to explore potential growth strategies, such as diversifying your product range or expanding into new markets, ensuring that your income grows alongside your infrastructure.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
You own everything after deployment — no platforms, no subscriptions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Nigeria without PayPal?
You can accept payments in Nigeria by using NOWPayments, which allows you to receive over 300 cryptocurrencies directly, eliminating the need for traditional banking services.
Can I sell ebooks from Pakistan without Stripe?
Yes, you can sell ebooks from Pakistan by utilizing cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments, ensuring seamless transactions without Stripe.
What cryptocurrencies can I use for payments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base and providing flexibility in payment options.
How fast can I process transactions?
Using USDT on the Tron network, transactions settle in under 60 seconds, allowing for quick payment confirmations and efficient customer experiences.
Is there a way to scale my digital product sales?
Yes, you can scale your sales by adding more products, utilizing marketing strategies, and employing insights from the scaling playbook in the Complete Builder Kit.
